whatAreCookies.title: What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.description: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and analyzing how you use our site.

howWeUse.title: How we use cookies
howWeUse.description: We use different types of cookies for various purposes:
howWeUse.essentialDescription: These make the site work: page navigation, your chosen language and protection against automated traffic.
howWeUse.analyticsDescription: We do not use analytics cookies today: the site analytics (Plausible, self-hosted) work without cookies or persistent identifiers.
howWeUse.preferenceDescription: These remember your preferences, such as language.
howWeUse.marketingDescription: We do not use marketing or advertising cookies today.

types.title: Cookies we use
types.localStorage: Your cookie choice and the light/dark theme are kept in your browser's local storage; they are not sent to our servers.

thirdParty.title: Third-party cookies
thirdParty.description: Some pages may include content from third-party services (for example, embedded videos or posts). Those services may set their own cookies, which we do not control; we recommend reviewing their policies.

managing.title: Managing cookies
managing.description: You can control and manage cookies in your browser settings. Please note that removing or blocking cookies may impact your user experience and parts of our website may no longer be fully accessible.
browserItems: See the cookies stored and delete them one by one
Clear all cookies when you close the browser
Open a private or incognito browsing session

preferences.title: Your preferences
preferences.description: You can change your choice at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser; the cookie notice will appear again on your next visit.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.description: We may update this policy to reflect changes in our practices or for legal or operational reasons. We will publish the new version on this page with its revision date.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: If you have questions about this Cookie Policy, write to us:
contact.responsible: Data controller: Innovaciones MADFAM S.A.S. de C.V.
contact.channel: Channel: the contact form on madfam.io (madfam.io/en/contact)

banner.title: Cookies on this site
banner.description: We only use necessary and preference cookies. We use no analytics or advertising cookies: our analytics (Plausible, self-hosted) works without cookies.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.description: keep the site working and protect it from automated traffic.

footer.text: Details in our <cookies>Cookie Policy</cookies> and our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
